name: tcgen05
title: tcgen05
intro: How the model treats the `tcgen05` instructions other than Tensor Memory allocation: the MMA kinds and descriptors, where operands and results lie in shared and Tensor Memory, the cells that loads, stores and copies access, `tcgen05.commit`, the tcgen05 fences, the order in which the Tensor Core performs its accesses and the values it produces. Concepts come first, then the rules.
concepts_intro: The definitions a reader needs to follow the rules. Each text is the Lean doc comment, and each entry links to its Lean source.
rules_intro: Each rule is a contract block of the Lean source. Its statement says what the rule means for programs. The source quotes the PTX ISA 9.5 text the rule rests on, and the direction says how the rule relates to that text. Interpretations (EXT) are readings of the PTX text that the model adopts beyond what the text states. The fields that reviewers check against the Lean bodies are collected under Details for reviewers. The rules `DEP-TC-FENCE` and `ERR-TC-COMMIT-GROUP` are in the mbarrier chapter, and the rule `ERR-ALIGNED-MISMATCH` for the warp-collective instructions is in the barriers chapter.
